tagline.en: Your custom course, shot while you choose the plot
tagline.zh-CN: 边选剧情边开拍,一门只属于你的课
tagline.ja: 展開を選ぶたびに撮影される、あなただけのコース

description.en: Each 5-15s narrated segment ends on two real choices — go deeper or advance, a worked example or an analogy. Both continuations are already shot while you watch, so the next clip plays the instant you click. Visual idea: a paused video frame on a dark stage with two glowing choice cards beneath it, a branching path faintly drawn behind.
description.zh-CN: 每段带口播的短视频结尾都有两个真实的选择——深入或前进、例子或类比。你观看时下一步已在后台拍好,点击即播。
description.ja: 各セグメントの終わりに本物の選択肢が2つ。視聴中に次のクリップは撮影済み、クリックで即再生。

title.zh-CN: 每个知识点都有据可查
title.ja: すべての知識に監査可能な裏付け

description.en: The video model is never trusted with knowledge: formulas and diagrams are rendered by code, derivations are run and verified, claims carry citations — all pinned to an evidence panel on every segment, and narration is transcribed back and checked word-for-word. Visual idea: a video frame of a chalkboard diagram side-by-side with the code-rendered figure it faithfully reproduces, an evidence panel listing citations and a passing verification check.
description.zh-CN: 视频模型从不被信任生成知识:公式与图表由代码渲染、推导经代码验证、结论带引用,全部挂在每段的依据面板上;口播还会被转写回来逐字核对。
description.ja: 数式や図はコードで描画・検証され、出典付き。ナレーションも文字起こしで逐語チェック。

title.ja: 9つのスタイルをその場でオーディション

description.en: Chalkboard, elegant math animation, ink comic, documentary, watercolor storybook, pixel quest and more — the agent shoots the same hook in three fitting styles and lets you pick; upload a photo and a consistent character hosts your whole course. Visual idea: a 3-up film-strip of the same lesson fragment rendered in three wildly different visual styles.
description.zh-CN: 黑板粉笔、数学动画、水墨漫画、纪录片、水彩绘本、像素游戏……agent 用同一段内容拍三种画风让你挑;传一张照片,还能让固定角色贯穿整门课。
description.ja: 同じ内容を3スタイルで撮影して選べる。写真を渡せば専属キャラがコースを案内。

title.ja: 学び終えても、コースマップは残る

description.en: When you finish, the whole journey stands as an explorable canvas — every branch you took (and the ones you didn't), replayable end to end, with a recap written from your actual path. Visual idea: an infinite canvas viewed from above, video thumbnails connected as a branching tree with one glowing traversed path.
description.zh-CN: 学完之后,整段旅程沉淀为一张可探索的画布——走过和没走过的分支都在,可整段重播,课后总结按你的真实路径生成。
description.ja: 学習後は旅全体が探索可能なキャンバスに。実際の経路からふりかえりも生成。
